sections.title: Unit 33: The Literary Canon in Schools and Public Life, 2012–2026
body: Between 2012 and 2026 the question of which authors and works the schools teach, who publishes them and who supports literary life was a subject of political decisions and public debate. Each step was welcomed by some and criticised by others.

In five short accounts you follow these events year by year, name who judged them how, and practise the forms a neutral history needs: attribution, comparison, participles, contrast within a sentence and open questions. The period ends with the parliamentary election of 12 April 2026.
